steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato into 2 cm cubes; finely dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until softened and translucent.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and turmeric; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sweet potato cubes, cooked lentils, coconut milk, and unsalted vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 18 to 20 minutes, until sweet potato is completely tender.
Remove from heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Use an immersion blender to blend the soup partially, leaving some texture, about 5 seconds.
Ladle into bowls; yields about 1.8 litres · 4 family portions. Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 2 months.
